name: Mocean
label: Mocean — Mocean REST API
description: Mocean via the official Mocean REST API. Base https://rest.moceanapi.com/rest/2. Docs: https://moceanapi.com/docs/. APAC sender-ID rules. Query auth uses mocean-api-secret (auth.configKey) plus mocean-api-key config. Official rest.moceanapi.com. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data}. Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Mocean operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"send-sms"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-sms | send-voice. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: mocean-to
schema.description: Destination MSISDN for send-sms / send-voice. Example: 60123456789.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-sms, send-voice. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: API secret
configurationParameters.description: Mocean API secret. Sent as query mocean-api-secret (OfficialApiNode query auth). StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: mocean-api-key
configurationParameters.description: Mocean API key (query mocean-api-key). Pair with secret.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
